full_judgment: 2. In the writ petition, the petitioners state that the land measuring an area of 64.5 acres appertaining to C.S. Plots No.79, 80 and 82 under Mouza Dhaka City, Sheet No.38, Word No.2 corresponding to SA Plot No.3505, 3573 and 3512 under SA Khatian No.1960 and 1964 respectively (the schedule property) belonged to late Meer Md. Nawab Ali. After his death Meer Md. Khizir Ali as son inherited the property. After death of Meer Md. Khizri All the petitioners and four others became the owners of the schedule property by inheritance. The schedule property was acquired by the respondents under LA Case No.2 of 1997-98 for construction of flood control embankment under taken by the Water Development Board. Out of nine co-shares, four co-heirs were given their proportionate compensation showing the schedule property as viti land leaving the five petitioners although the property was ejmaly property. The petitioners produced all papers in support of their title and possession as per requirement of the respondents. Despite the respondents refrained themselves from making the payment in favour of the petitioners.
